description:
Hushfacebook v0.4.0 targets Facebook 580.0.0.51.74 (com.facebook.katana), and 577.0.0.50.72 still works.

This release gathers the fixes since v0.3.4 and keeps 43 patches. A copy renamed with Morphe's Clone app patch recognises itself again, the AMOLED status bar stays black after Recent Apps, and Block background-return feed refresh can keep your place with no time limit.

Running saves are listed under Downloads with a Cancel button, a save cut short is cleaned up when Facebook starts, and errors stop a save sooner. Diagnostic reports always carry build details and leave out more private values. A way Facebook could swap sponsored posts into the feed past the filter is closed.

Validation: 1094 runtime tests passed locally. All 473 patch tests passed too, along with both Android lints. All 43 patches applied to Facebook 580.0.0.51.74 and 577.0.0.50.72; resource and injected-code checks passed.

Most of the new behaviour hasn't been tried on a phone yet. Some device-specific reports remain under investigation, including WhatsApp import, Xiaomi Gallery audio, Media settings and a missing Reel Download button. Review diagnostic reports for private data before sharing them.

Needs Morphe Manager 1.32.0 or newer. Patch the arm64-v8a, Android 11+ bundle of Facebook 580.0.0.51.74, build 475019344, or 577.0.0.50.72, build 474426275. The .mpp is a patch bundle, not a Facebook APK. Keep the manager's existing signing key when updating.
